snippet.title: Roman Sands RE:Build & Paratopic: Overdub - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The resort never closed. You were simply early. Thank you for waiting! ❤️

Today, we’re excited to share that Roman Sands RE:Build and Paratopic: Overdub will launch on September 16th!

Pay no attention to the sun.

https://serenityforge.com/games/roman-sands-re-build

Rewind the tape.

https://serenityforge.com/games/paratopic-overdub

We'll see you there.
